plugins.name: prowodo-tasks
plugins.description: Manage ProWoDo tasks, backlog, sprints, reminders and Daily Resumes from Claude Code. Auto-triggers on task/planning mentions; bundles the ProWoDo MCP server (OAuth, no API key).

plugins.name: i3deploy-release
plugins.description: Cut i3deploy releases (ServiceRelease + ProjectRelease, user/technical changelogs) from Claude Code or claude.ai. Drafts from git + session + memory + whichever task manager you use, dedups, and publishes via the bundled i3deploy MCP server (OAuth, no API key). Can target a release at a named audience with its own changelog and feed. Standalone — no ProWoDo required.
